substantive_implementation_consequences.file: MTF OHLC Lines with Breakout & Retracement Labels.txt
substantive_implementation_consequences.observed: Custom duration allows hours0/minutes0; preset new-interval detection uses minute modulus except240-minute time change. barsInInterval divides requested duration by chart multiplier. Previous interval OHLC freezes at new interval; current high/low/close mutate. Break flags are gated by showBreakoutLabels, retrace by showRetraceLabels and bar_index>intervalStartBar. Fibonacci geometry is drawn over the previous interval after it completes.
substantive_implementation_consequences.implementation_consequence: Reject zero/unsupported intervals and use explicit calendar-aligned interval IDs rather than assuming regular chart spacing or a divisible chart timeframe. Missing boundary bars and same-timeframe minute0 bars need deterministic handling. Separate visualization toggles from corrected state updates. One OHLC bar containing both a breakout and return cannot establish intrabar ordering; bar_index>intervalStartBar only excludes the interval opening bar, not same-bar sequencing. Fibonacci levels become known after source interval completion even when backdrawn; percent breakout requires a nonzero signed-domain denominator and mapped levels require grid policy.
